title: tel: robot to laptop telemetry
description: Sent 20 times a second over UDP to whoever sent the last packet; over USB, once per J command. Readers must ignore keys they don't know.

pitch.description: Tilt in DEGREES, + leaning forward (battery side). Balances near the trim (+5.6 with the phone tilted up).

rate.description: Tilt rate in DEGREES per second, + tipping forward.

vl.description: Left wheel speed, m/s, + forward (commanded wheel speed).

batt.description: Battery volts. Always null today: nothing measures it (C-10).

state.description: idle: motors off (also while parked). balance: holding position. drive: moving or turning.

fault.description: Why the motors last turned off, as free text (for example "stop command", "fell over (tilt > 30 deg)"); null after g. Fixed names are proposed in C-1.

x.description: Distance driven since g, m, + forward (average of both wheels; not a room coordinate).

yaw.description: Heading since g in DEGREES, + left (gyro).

ack.description: seq of the last JSON command received, 0 until one arrives (#14).
